Version 1.0.1 (phy-cwv-budget-guard)

- Updated author and version metadata.
- Added a homepage URL to the skill manifest.
- No functional or code changes. Documentation/metadata only.

Initial release — Core Web Vitals budget enforcement and diagnostic for any framework.

- Runs Lighthouse locally (via npx), no external cloud required.
- Compares LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, and TTFB against configurable thresholds in .cwv-budget.json.
- Fails CI if any metric regresses, with detailed attribution (source file, image, JS, or blocking resource).
- Provides actionable fix recommendations for every failing metric.
- Tracks trends and previous runs with a local history file.
- Easy triggers in chat/CLI for "core web vitals", "performance regression", and related phrases.
